sub_sector.value: Industrial flow control; fiber processing; material handling

manufacturing_type.detail: Manufactures rotary unions and builds fiber processing systems, baling equipment, and bulk material handling equipment.

production_model.detail: Builds custom-engineered fluid sealing and transfer products to application requirements and supplies customized rolled profiles.

product_complexity.detail: Custom-engineered flow control products, fiber processing machinery, and systems for handling bulk and discrete materials.

production_role.detail: Supplies complete fiber processing and material handling equipment alongside rotary unions and electrical slip rings.

end_market_exposure.detail: Paper, packaging, wood products, mining, food processing, energy, aerospace, defense, medical, semiconductor, and agro-industrial applications.

notes: The production model reflects custom builds, with stock production unconfirmed.
